An agent with your main email password misreads one thread, and every client gets the wrong message before you wake up.
Ten minutes of setup prevents that.
This is The One-Person Company, lesson three: logins, access and approval rules.
In this lesson: four rules that keep an always-on agent safe.
Use an official connector or a separate limited user, and never share your main password.
Start read only, then drafts, then narrow actions, and widen only when the agent has earned it.
What it does alone, what it asks about, what it hands to you, and what it never does.
Four: know your off switch before you turn it on.
And remember: stopping an agent doesn't undo what it did.
That's why the approval rule matters most.
